title: A Statistical Theory of Gated Attention through the Lens of Hierarchical Mixture of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2602.01468v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-attention has greatly contributed to the success of the widely used Transformer architecture by enabling learning from data with long-range dependencies. In an effort to improve performance, a gated attention model that leverages a gating mechanism within the multi-head self-attention has recently been proposed as a promising alternative. Gated attention has been empirically demonstrated to increase the expressiveness of low-rank mapping in standard attention and even to eliminate the attention sink phenomenon. Despite its efficacy, a clear theoretical understanding of gated attention's benefits remains lacking in the literature. To close this gap, we rigorously show that each entry in a gated attention matrix or a multi-head self-attention matrix can be written as a hierarchical mixture of experts. By recasting learning as an expert estimation problem, we demonstrate that gated attention is more sample-efficient than multi-head

translated_title: 从分层专家混合视角看门控注意力的统计理论
translated_abstract: 自注意力机制通过使模型能够从具有长程依赖关系的数据中学习，为广泛使用的Transformer架构的成功做出了巨大贡献。为了提升性能，最近有人提出了一种在多头自注意力中引入门控机制的门控注意力模型，作为一种有前景的替代方案。门控注意力已在实证上被证明能够增强标准注意力中低秩映射的表达能力，甚至能够消除注意力汇聚现象。尽管效果显著，但文献中仍缺乏对门控注意力优势的清晰理论理解。为填补这一空白，我们严格地证明了门控注意力矩阵或多头自注意力矩阵中的每个元素都可以写成分层专家混合的形式。通过将学习重新表述为专家估计问题，我们证明了门控注意力比多头自注意力更具样本效率。
tldr: 该论文首次为门控注意力建立了统计理论，证明门控注意力矩阵的每个元素可写成分层专家混合的形式，并由此从理论上证明门控注意力比多头自注意力更具样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a statistical theory of gated attention by rigorously showing that each entry of the gated attention matrix can be expressed as a hierarchical mixture of experts, thereby proving that gated attention is more sample-efficient than multi-head self-attention.
